title: Esports Awards 2026 Streamer of the Year nominees revealed as IShowSpeed eyes third win
summary_full: The Esports Awards 2026 have revealed the 12 creators nominated for Streamer of the Year. IShowSpeed, Kai Cenat, Jynxzi, CaseOh and several other major names made the shortlist. Speed has won the award for the last two years, giving the category an extra storyline. Voting is already open, with fans able to support their pick until November 10, 2026, through the official Esports Awards website.
